```{r setup, include=FALSE,echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(igraph)
library(lglasso)
set.seed(1)
```




```{r}
adjMatrixPre=as.matrix(read.csv(file="../docs/adjMatrixPre.CSV",row.names = 1))
pre=graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adjMatrixPre, mode = "undirected")
adjMatrixPost=as.matrix(read.csv(file="../docs/adjMatrixPost.CSV",row.names = 1))
post=graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adjMatrixPost, mode = "undirected")
```


```{r}
edges_pre <- as_edgelist(pre, names = TRUE)
edges_post <- as_edgelist(post, names = TRUE)

diff_pre_not_post <- as_edgelist(difference(pre, post))
print("Edges in pre but not post:")
print(diff_pre_not_post)

# Edges in Graph 2 that are NOT in Graph 1
diff_post_not_pre <- as_edgelist(difference(post, pre))
print("Edges in post but not pre:")
print(diff_post_not_pre)
```
```{r}
# Install and load the package
install.packages("forestplot")
library(forestplot)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Create a dummy dataset
base_data <- tibble(
  variable  = c("Age (>65 vs ≤65)", "Sex (Female vs Male)", "Treatment (B vs A)", "Smoker (Yes vs No)"),
  mean      = c(1.25, 0.92, 2.10, 1.45),
  lower     = c(0.95, 0.61, 1.55, 0.88),
  upper     = c(1.65, 1.38, 2.85, 2.30),
  p_value   = c("0.110", "0.680", "<0.001", "0.150")
)

# 2. Structure the data with a header row for the final table layout
plot_data <- base_data %>%
  # Insert an empty row at the top to serve as the header
  add_row(variable = "Variable", p_value = "p-value", .before = 1)

# 3. Generate the forest plot
plot_data %>%
  forestplot(
    labeltext = c(variable, p_value), # Columns to display as text on the left
    mean = mean,                      # Point estimates
    lower = lower,                    # Lower CI bounds
    upper = upper,                    # Upper CI bounds
    is.summary = c(TRUE, rep(FALSE, nrow(base_data))), # Bold the first (header) row
    clip = c(0.1, 3.0),               # Truncate CIs if they go past these limits
    xlog = FALSE,                     # Set to TRUE if plotting Odds Ratios / Risk Ratios
    xlab = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)",
    col = fpColors(box = "royalblue", line = "darkblue", summary = "black")
  )

```
